whyCareReason: Atlanta look to shake off Monday night heartbreak while Tampa Bay aim to seize early control of the NFC South.
teaser: Thursday 8 October, 8:15 PM ET on Prime Video. Division supremacy on the line in Tampa.
story: NFL Week 5 kicks off Thursday night as the Atlanta Falcons travel to Raymond James Stadium to battle the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. The Falcons enter on a short turnaround after falling 26-24 to the Saints on Monday night in New Orleans. Meanwhile, Kansas City (4-0) and Minnesota (4-0) remain the league's only undefeated squads after Week 4 comebacks. An early divisional win on Thursday gives either Tampa Bay or Atlanta vital leverage in the NFC playoff hunt.
stakes: First place in the NFC South and momentum heading into October.
rivalryAngle: Classic division rivalry under prime-time lights.
